units.source: Quick edit
units.context: Quick edit

units.source: __TRILIUM_PH_0__Quick edit__TRILIUM_PH_1__ provides an alternative to the standard tab-based navigation and editing.
units.context: Quick edit

units.source: Instead of clicking on a note which switches the __TRILIUM_PH_0__Note Tree__TRILIUM_PH_1__ to the newly selected note, or navigating between two different __TRILIUM_PH_2__Tabs__TRILIUM_PH_3__, the __TRILIUM_PH_4__Quick edit__TRILIUM_PH_5__ feature opens as a popup window that can be easily dismissed.
units.context: Quick edit

units.source: This feature is also well integrated with __TRILIUM_PH_0__Collections__TRILIUM_PH_1__ such as the calendar view, which makes it easy to edit entries without having to go back and forth between the child note and the calendar.
units.context: Quick edit

units.source: Feature highlights__TRILIUM_PH_0__
units.context: Quick edit > Feature highlights

units.source: All note types are supported, including __TRILIUM_PH_0__Collections__TRILIUM_PH_1__.
units.context: Quick edit > Feature highlights

units.source: Note that the __TRILIUM_PH_0__Note List__TRILIUM_PH_1__ will not be displayed, except for notes of type __TRILIUM_PH_2__Collections__TRILIUM_PH_3__.
units.context: Quick edit > Feature highlights

units.source: For __TRILIUM_PH_0__Text__TRILIUM_PH_1__ notes, depending on user preference, both the floating and classic editors are supported. See __TRILIUM_PH_2__Formatting toolbar__TRILIUM_PH_3__.
units.context: Quick edit > Feature highlights

units.source: The title and the note and the icon are editable, just like a normal tab.
units.context: Quick edit > Feature highlights

units.source: The note's actions and its menu are shown in the header of the popup, as in the title row of a tab.
units.context: Quick edit > Feature highlights

units.source: When other notes link to the note, a button with a link icon lists the __TRILIUM_PH_0__Backlinks__TRILIUM_PH_1__. Pressing one opens that note in the popup.
units.context: Quick edit > Feature highlights

units.source: The menu items that only work in a tab are not shown: __TRILIUM_PH_0__Note map__TRILIUM_PH_1__, __TRILIUM_PH_2__Full width__TRILIUM_PH_3__ and __TRILIUM_PH_4__Convert into attachment__TRILIUM_PH_5__.
units.context: Quick edit > Feature highlights

units.source: __TRILIUM_PH_0__Find__TRILIUM_PH_1__ in the menu, or __TRILIUM_PH_2__Ctrl__TRILIUM_PH_3__+__TRILIUM_PH_4__F__TRILIUM_PH_5__ on the desktop application, opens the __TRILIUM_PH_6__Search in note__TRILIUM_PH_7__ bar at the bottom of the popup. It searches the note in the popup, not the note in the tab behind it.
units.context: Quick edit > Feature highlights

units.source: A help page opened from the popup, such as through the help button of the note type, opens in a second popup on top of it. Closing that popup returns to the note being edited.
units.context: Quick edit > Feature highlights

units.source: The __TRILIUM_PH_0__Promoted Attributes__TRILIUM_PH_1__ are also displayed.
units.context: Quick edit > Feature highlights

units.source: This integrates well with __TRILIUM_PH_0__Collections__TRILIUM_PH_1__ where there are predefined attributes such as the __TRILIUM_PH_2__Start date__TRILIUM_PH_3__ and __TRILIUM_PH_4__End date__TRILIUM_PH_5__, allowing for easy editing.
units.context: Quick edit > Feature highlights

units.source: Accessing the quick edit__TRILIUM_PH_0__
units.context: Quick edit > Accessing the quick edit

units.source: From the __TRILIUM_PH_0__Note Tree__TRILIUM_PH_1__:
units.context: Quick edit > Accessing the quick edit

units.source: Right click on a note and select __TRILIUM_PH_0__Quick edit__TRILIUM_PH_1__.
units.context: Quick edit > Accessing the quick edit

units.source: or, press __TRILIUM_PH_0__Ctrl__TRILIUM_PH_1__+__TRILIUM_PH_2__Right click__TRILIUM_PH_3__ on a note.
units.context: Quick edit > Accessing the quick edit

units.source: On __TRILIUM_PH_0__Internal (reference) links__TRILIUM_PH_1__:
units.context: Quick edit > Accessing the quick edit

units.source: Right click and select __TRILIUM_PH_0__Quick edit__TRILIUM_PH_1__.
units.context: Quick edit > Accessing the quick edit

units.source: or, press __TRILIUM_PH_0__Ctrl__TRILIUM_PH_1__+__TRILIUM_PH_2__Right click__TRILIUM_PH_3__ on the link.
units.context: Quick edit > Accessing the quick edit

units.source: On a __TRILIUM_PH_0__Note Tooltip__TRILIUM_PH_1__, press the quick edit icon.
units.context: Quick edit > Accessing the quick edit

units.source: In __TRILIUM_PH_0__Collections__TRILIUM_PH_1__:
units.context: Quick edit > Accessing the quick edit

units.source: For __TRILIUM_PH_0__Calendar__TRILIUM_PH_1__:
units.context: Quick edit > Accessing the quick edit

units.source: Clicking on an event will open that event for quick editing.
units.context: Quick edit > Accessing the quick edit

units.source: If the calendar is for the __TRILIUM_PH_0__Day Notes__TRILIUM_PH_1__ root, clicking on the day number will open the popup for that day note.
units.context: Quick edit > Accessing the quick edit

units.source: For __TRILIUM_PH_0__Geo Map__TRILIUM_PH_1__:
units.context: Quick edit > Accessing the quick edit

units.source: Clicking on a marker will open that marker, but only if the map is in read-only mode.
units.context: Quick edit > Accessing the quick edit

units.source: Handling of read-only notes__TRILIUM_PH_0__
units.context: Quick edit > Handling of read-only notes

units.source: The Quick edit feature has a unique behavior for __TRILIUM_PH_0__Read-Only Notes__TRILIUM_PH_1__:
units.context: Quick edit > Handling of read-only notes

units.source: If the note is read-only due to performance reasons (auto read-only), then the note is made editable for quick editing.
units.context: Quick edit > Handling of read-only notes

units.source: If the note has been manually set to read-only, then the note is read-only to prevent accidental change.
units.context: Quick edit > Handling of read-only notes

units.source: In this case, the note can still be edited by on-screen instructions.
units.context: Quick edit > Handling of read-only notes

units.source: Mobile support__TRILIUM_PH_0__
units.context: Quick edit > Mobile support

units.source: On a phone, the popup uses the full width of the screen and the note's content keeps the same side margin as a __TRILIUM_PH_0__Text__TRILIUM_PH_1__ note. The __TRILIUM_PH_2__Formatting toolbar__TRILIUM_PH_3__ of a text note sits at the foot of the dialog, below the note; its dropdowns open upwards so the keyboard does not cover them.
units.context: Quick edit > Mobile support
